name: sonic-mystic
description: Huyền học — Tử vi from grandma's notes, and later chiêm tinh, nhân số học, Kinh Dịch, tarot: one engine package, one API, one web.

scripts.build:api: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @mystic/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @mystic/web
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w @mystic/api && npm run build -w @mystic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck -w @mystic/api && npm run typecheck -w @mystic/web
scripts.test: npm run build:engine && npm run test -w @mystic/engine && npm run test -w @mystic/kb && npm run test -w @mystic/api
scripts.kb:book: npm run build:engine && npm run book -w @mystic/kb
scripts.kb:bundle: npm run build:engine && npm run bundle -w @mystic/kb
scripts.kb:numerology: npm run build:engine && npm run numerology -w @mystic/kb
scripts.kb:astrology: npm run build:engine && npm run astrology -w @mystic/kb
